name: Emit endpoint config
description: Emits the deployer's current external endpoint + auth state as task outputs so the live-test-runner can switch its apiUrl mid-suite after a self-reconfigure/upgrade. Reads truth from /etc/pve/lxc/<vm_id>.conf (OIDC env lines, /etc/ssl/addon mountpoint) — never from scenario-request params. Three outputs: endpoint_url, endpoint_requires_oidc (true|false), endpoint_oidc_issuer.
